title: Number Quest Unit 3 · The Machine Hall (Pro)

items.q: Which expression means 4 less than 6 times n?
misconceptions: subtracted 4 from n before multiplying by 6
wrote the subtraction the wrong way round
items.why: 6 times n is 6n. "4 less than" that means start with 6n and take 4 away: 6n − 4. For n = 2 that is 12 − 4 = 8.

items.q: What is the value of 2n² + 3 when n = 4?
items.why: Only n is squared: 4² = 4 × 4 = 16. Then multiply: 2 × 16 = 32. Then add: 32 + 3 = 35.

items.q: A crate holds 8 toys. A truck carries c full crates and 5 loose toys. Which expression gives the number of toys on the truck?
misconceptions: grouped the loose toys with the crates before multiplying
added 8 and 5 instead of multiplying 8 by c
swapped the toys in a crate with the loose toys
items.why: Each of the c crates holds 8 toys, which is 8c. The 5 loose toys are added once: 8c + 5. With 2 crates that is 16 + 5 = 21 toys.

misconceptions: multiplied only the first term by 5
added 5 and 3 instead of multiplying them
multiplied only the second term by 5
items.why: The 5 multiplies both parts of the sum: 5 × x and 5 × 3. So 5(x + 3) = 5x + 15. Check with x = 1: 5 × 4 = 20 and 5 + 15 = 20.

items.q: Which pair of expressions has the same value for every number x?
misconceptions: multiplied only the first term by 3
items.why: Three of the same thing added is 3 of it: x + x + x = 3x for every x. The other pairs differ for x = 3: 6 and 9, 9 and 6, 12 and 10.

misconceptions: added the x terms instead of subtracting
combined the 3 with the x terms
items.why: The whole sum is taken away, so both terms are subtracted: 7x − 2x − 3 = 5x − 3. Check with x = 1: 7 − 5 = 2 and 5 − 3 = 2.

items.q: A line multiplies its input by 6, and the output is 42. Which input solves 6x = 42?
misconceptions: multiplied by 6 again instead of undoing it
items.why: Dividing undoes multiplying: 42 ÷ 6 = 7. Check by putting it back: 6 × 7 = 42, so x = 7.

misconceptions: stopped after subtracting 9 and did not divide by 2
dropped the negative sign of the answer
items.why: Undo plus 9 first: 3 − 9 = −6, so 2x = −6. Then undo times 2: −6 ÷ 2 = −3. Check: 2 × (−3) + 9 = 3.

misconceptions: divided by 4 and stopped before subtracting 3
added 3 after dividing instead of subtracting it
items.why: The line adds 3 and then multiplies by 4, so undo times 4 first: 32 ÷ 4 = 8. Then undo plus 3: 8 − 3 = 5. Check: 4 × (5 + 3) = 32.
